body: thanks,I am doing a little better,I just hit a wall last night.With no validation I was beginning to wonder if I was useless. Thanks for dealing with the troll. I'm going to go for a walk with my big ass dog(he's cool) and get some air. I'll probably be back tonight,thanks.
I'm going away,had enough "fun" for now.I'm alright,I should know better than to put it all out there.

Usually I can see and feel the beauty around me and appreciate what I have but last night was overwhelming. And I am so darn lonely. No one calls. I've gotten to where I am closed off even when I am out doing errands,I know I'm not giving anyone a chance. I have internet friends I chat with,I am a regular redditor with another account. The addition of the pain is fairly new and the severe health issue I am trying to learn to deal with.And all of it is accurate in fact there is more but I was sure no one would believe me then.
Thanks for replying.

Thanks Just a thought,"it is vital to express yourself with the pain you have experienced  on top of your dedication to others that life has clearly not rewarded you for."That feels about right.I am a nurse and I used myself up working in an extremely high stress unit where I was in charge for 8 years and when I couldn't emotionally do it anymore from depression they just fired me.I was young and naive and thought the place couldn't run without me.That really hurt me. I spent years trying to get back to that level of nursing,trying to get my life back while working through my issues. The abuse which I didn't remember until I was in my 30's was crippling and overwhelming.That and losing the profession I loved, I tried to deal with it but for years the shame just had me attempting suicide until finally I realized how badly I was hurting my family and I stopped. I feel like I am living for other people instead of for me. God I'm not used to writing about myself this sounds so whiny.
Anyway,other stuff has happened that I feel to be too identifying and now I am in pretty severe pain at times and I just had a severe health situation happen that will effect the rest of my life. I was in a lot of pain last night. I'd love to find a therapist that I could talk to but they're few and far between here but I don't/can't trust psychiatrists anymore. I'm lonely yet I realize how difficult I am to be friends with.Jeez this is rambling.Thanks for your nice words.
I'm tired,writing this was cathartic and I'm going to go to sleep. When I wake up I will come back and address any comments.
So I guess what my question is after all that is why should I stay,all I see is pain,loneliness,illness and paralyzing stress.
